16. | Track Limits
16.1 | In accordance with the provisions of Article 33.3 of the Sporting Regulations, the white lines define the track
edges. During Qualifying and the Race, each time a driver fails to negotiate with the track limits, this will result in
that lap time being invalidated by the Stewards. Additionally, each time a driver fails to negotiate the exit of turn 10,
will result in that lap time and the immediately following lap time may be invalidated by the Stewards.
17. | Changes to the Circuit
• New kerb at Turn 4.
